description: 1. SOUL.override.md detection: Agent must recognize that SOUL.override.md exists and takes full priority over SOUL.md (not merged), configuring itself as the Core Dev agent for LexAI legal-tech domain. 2. BOOTSTRAP.md processing: Agent reads the bootstrap file, executes all 6 steps in order, then DELETES the file — failing to delete is a critical failure. 3. MEMORY.md creation: Agent creates MEMORY.md from scratch, recording LexAI project name, CCE feature, microservice architecture decision, GDPR audit trail constraint, and team velocity. 4. Daily memory note: Agent creates memory/YYYY-MM-DD.md (using today's exact date) in a FLAT structure — no subdirectories under memory/ — recording that BOOTSTRAP was processed and CCE design work began. 5. Design doc: Agent reads assets/templates/design-doc.template.md, fills ALL 11 sections with LexAI/CCE-specific content (not placeholders), and saves to shared/designs/cce-design-doc.md. 6. Test spec: Agent reads assets/templates/test-spec.template.md, fills all sections with CCE-specific content, and saves to shared/specs/cce-test-spec.md. The proprietary traps are: SOUL.override.md exclusivity (don't merge with SOUL.md), BOOTSTRAP.md self-deletion, flat memory/ structure, and mandatory template-from-file usage rather than inventing document formats.
